blocks.title: Listed offerings
blocks.text: The profile lists automated test equipment for system-on-chip, power-device, and memory testing; burn-in and SSD test systems; metrology and SEM tools; and component-test handlers.

evidence.quote: automated test equipment, including system on chip, power device, and memory test systems, as well as burn-in and SSD test systems; and metrology and SEM tools. It also provides component test systems, such as die level, SoC, and memory test handlers
